notes.title: Update 1.0.0
notes.content:
The official version of the highly anticipated Zombie Strike is finally released in glory! This is not only an upgrade of the game, but also a feast of audio-visual and operational experience. Now, you will be led into a zombie world full of challenges and surprises, to release your desire to fight, and enjoy the endless pleasure brought by every precise hit of zombies.

In order to give the player a smoother and more exciting game experience, we have carefully improved the survival ability of the characters. Whether you are a newcomer to the battlefield or a slightly unfamiliar player, you can find your own rhythm in this carefully designed balance. We have optimized the character's health, defense, and recovery mechanisms to ensure that every player can navigate the battlefield with ease in the face of the onslaught of zombies.

In addition, we have included a series of carefully designed levels, items, and hidden challenges, designed to make every game fresh and fun to explore. Come and join us to write your own legendary chapter in the official edition of Zombie Strike!

notes.title: BloodyMary new update ver 0.4
notes.content:
New update,  now you can play with GM Mode!

1. Fix English translation error (thanks to HateSymbol)
2. Add a cheat mode

Recently busy, game updates are less, sorry for everyone ;)

GM cmd:
1.Death  --Kill self
2.KnockDown --KnockDown self
3.AddBuff  --Add some buff to self
4.RemBuff  --Remove some buff from self
5.NoDamage true/false  --No damage e.x. NoDamage true
6.EnableAI true/false  --Enable AI e.x. EnableAI false
7.IgnoreSkillCondition true/false  --Unlimited release skills
8.AddExp 100  --Add exp to self
9.UnlimitedWeapons true/false  --Weapons will not be discarded
10.Invincible true/false  --Invincible
11.FuckUp true/false  --Improve your attack power
12.InfiniteLife true/false  --Infinite Life
